title: X-Pruner: eXplainable Pruning for Vision Transformers

layout.note: Two grey-framed panels side by side: Training (about 60% of the width) and Testing, whose frame is split by a horizontal line into an upper and a lower cell. In Training, oblique stacks of grids run from the weights and mask columns at the top left through a blue translucent cone to the lower stack, and a black arrow leads to the coloured output stack; in Testing the masks are reduced to one orange column, an orange cone narrows W to Pruned W, and the Batch x grid sits beside it. The phase names are bold words at the foot of each panel.

lesson: Draw a tensor operation as offset stacks of cell grids, keep one class colour from the mask columns through the slices to the outputs, and join the before and after matrices with a translucent cone labelled with the operation.
